steps.name: QC counts and metadata, flag/handle shallow sample
steps.context: Raw integer gene-level counts from Salmon, 12000 genes x 13 sample columns in counts.csv; metadata.csv has 12 rows (condition column) for the 6 AD-lesional vs 6 control unpaired single-batch design. sample_01's library size is flagged as ~4x below the cohort median in the data profile.
steps.question: Do the counts.csv (12000 genes x 13 samples) and metadata.csv (12 samples) column sets reconcile, what are the library sizes across the 6 AD-lesional vs 6 control samples, and how should sample_01's ~4x-below-median library size be handled before differential expression?
acceptance_criteria: Reports whether all count-matrix sample columns have a matching metadata row (12 vs 13 discrepancy resolved or documented and excess column dropped/explained)
Reports per-sample library size (total counts) and gene detection rate, with sample_01 quantified relative to the cohort median

Produces a documented decision (with justification) on sample_01: retain with standard DESeq2 size-factor normalization, or flag as sensitivity-analysis-only if QC metrics (e.g., low gene detection, high dropout) support exclusion
Outputs a cleaned counts matrix + metadata table used downstream, plus a QC report/plot (library size barplot, PCA or sample correlation)

steps.name: DESeq2 differential expression, AD lesional vs control
steps.context: Unpaired 6 vs 6 single-batch bulk RNA-seq design, ~12000 genes, human skin, atopic dermatitis lesional vs control. sample_01 is a shallow-library outlier handled per T1S1's decision.
steps.question: Which genes are significantly differentially expressed between AD-lesional and control skin (6 vs 6, unpaired, single batch), using the QC-cleaned count matrix and metadata from T1S1?
acceptance_criteria: Runs DESeq2 (or pyDESeq2) with condition (lesional vs control) as the sole design factor, using raw integer counts and default size-factor normalization unless T1S1 recommended an alternative for sample_01

Reports a full results table (log2FoldChange, p-value, padj) for all ~12000 genes, plus a sensitivity run excluding sample_01 to check whether its inclusion changes the significant gene set materially
Defines and reports significant DE genes at padj < 0.05 (and |log2FC| >= 1 as a secondary threshold), with counts of up- and down-regulated genes in lesional vs control
Produces an MA plot and a volcano plot annotating top genes
States explicitly whether conclusions are sensitive to sample_01's inclusion/exclusion

steps.name: Hallmark and WikiPathways enrichment of the AD lesional vs control DE signature
steps.context: Uses the ranked/DE gene list from T1S2 (human, ~12000 genes) against the MSigDB human Hallmark gene set collection (50 curated sets, h.all.v2026.1.Hs.symbols.gmt) and the human WikiPathways collection (wikipathways_Homo_sapiens.gmt), both staged in the reference store. If the WikiPathways reference is unavailable at run time, report Hallmark-only results and note the gap rather than failing the step.
steps.question: Which MSigDB Hallmark pathways and WikiPathways (human) gene sets are enriched among genes differentially expressed between AD-lesional and control skin?
acceptance_criteria: Runs pre-ranked GSEA (fgsea) on the full DESeq2 gene list ranked by a signed statistic (e.g., sign(log2FC) * -log10(pvalue) or the Wald stat) against the MSigDB human Hallmark gene sets (50 sets) and the human WikiPathways gene sets, reporting NES, p-value, and adjusted p-value (padj/FDR) per pathway

Also runs an over-representation test (clusterProfiler or fgsea hypergeometric) on the padj<0.05 significant DE gene subset from T1S2 against the same two gene-set collections, for cross-validation of directionality
Reports the top up- and down-enriched Hallmark pathways and top WikiPathways terms with FDR < 0.25 (GSEA convention) or FDR < 0.05 (ORA), with the member genes driving each leading-edge
Produces a summary plot (dot plot or barplot of NES vs -log10(FDR)) for the top pathways from each collection
If gene symbols in the counts matrix do not match GMT gene symbols, harmonizes via the human UniProt ID mapping reference and reports the match rate

plan.title: AD lesional vs control DE + hallmark enrichment
plan.analytical_narrative: Design is 6 lesional vs 6 control skin, unpaired, single batch, raw Salmon gene-level counts for ~12000 genes across 13 samples (12 metadata rows vs 13 count columns needs reconciliation). sample_01's library size is ~4x below median, which threatens both normalization and DE power, so QC/library-size diagnostics and a documented handling decision (down-weighting vs exclusion, tested both ways) come before DESeq2. Track 1 does count QC, DESeq2 differential expression (treated vs control), and volcano/summary visualization. Track 2 takes the DE result (ranked gene list) into hallmark (MSigDB h.all) and WikiPathways human enrichment via fgsea/clusterProfiler, using the human ID mapping reference only if a symbol harmonization step is needed. All steps operate on human (Homo sapiens) skin bulk RNA-seq data specifically for atopic dermatitis lesional vs control.
